description: TPO 114 T13-T20 8x Plum Tree to crown lift and remove limb. T10 & T11 2x Cyprus Tree to fell. T8 1x Conifer to remove dieback and T9 1x conifer to remove extending limb.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The trees are located in the rear gardens of 2 - 18 Langton Grove, Northwood. The mature trees appear to be in good condition and can be viewed from the properties on Langton Grove and from Kewferry Road. Collectively, the trees contribute toward the arboreal nature of the area, and have a moderate amenity value.

This application has been refused, as there is no arboricultural reason provided, and the application provides no details as to the extent of the works. Any future applications should clearly outline crown lift height, and to show what limb removal is being proposed.
In addition, no reasoning or evidence has been included to support the felling of T10 and T11.
Please note, dead branches may be removed without further application under exemption.
Having regard to the reasons given for the proposed work, the work is unjustified and will have a detrimental impact on the visual amenity and arboreal character of the area.
The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.
